title: Architecture Plan: Automated B2B Email & PDF Order Intake into ERP
brief: We receive ~80 B2B quote requests and supplier invoices daily via shared email with attached PDFs, scans, and Excel sheets. Ops staff manually re-key line items into ERP and routinely miss VAT ID mismatches, coil-vs-meter unit mix-ups, duplicate emails, and above-contract unit prices. Looking for reliable automation with human exception review before ERP posting.
summary: Deterministic Python handles email deduplication, tax/IBAN checksums, unit expansion, and contract-price reconciliation, while Vision OCR + LLM is isolated strictly to reading messy PDF tables and proposing SKU matches.

code: Attachment ingestion with SHA-256 idempotency keys so re-forwarded emails never create duplicate ERP bills
Strict Decimal line arithmetic (`qty × unit = total`), VAT/IBAN checksum checks, and pack-to-base unit expansion
Contract unit-price cap verification and idempotent ERP draft posting with retry/audit trail
ai: Structured line-item and supplier header extraction from skewed scans, stamps, and irregular PDF layouts
Fuzzy SKU resolution against the master catalog with deterministic technical-spec penalties (no silent spec swaps)

milestones.deliverable: Benchmark OCR extraction accuracy and discrepancy detection on your anonymized emails/PDFs
Email ingestion, PDF/XLSX parsers, contract/math verification engine, and draft ERP sync
Operator review queue for flagged mismatches, Docker Compose deployment, and test suite

monthlyOps: Cloud VPS ($12–$20/mo) + LLM/Vision API tokens for ~2,400 documents/mo: roughly $18–$32/mo (or $0 API cost on a self-hosted GPU with Qwen2.5-VL).
questions: Which ERP receives the validated order (Odoo, NetSuite, SAP B1, Axelor, or custom REST) and is there a staging sandbox?
Can anonymized PDFs hit zero-retention cloud APIs (Vertex/OpenAI), or does compliance require self-hosted local models?
Should a single low-confidence or over-cap line hold the entire invoice for operator review or allow partial posting?
